prompt_text: Camera: ARRI Alexa Mini, Anamorphic, oval bokeh, stretched flares, strong highlight bloom | cool digital-to-neon rendering, heavy highlight bloom, smeared anamorphic flares, visible grain in shadows | 75mm, f/2.0. Camera Style: Aggressive erratic handheld with whip-pan transitions and macro intrusions, one dead-still centered lock for the final stare, no production gear in frame, no slow motion. Light: Institutional window glow in milky cyan spilling through frosted glass, sodium-amber pockets burning in highlights, harsh parking-lot lamps from above creating hard pools on damp asphalt, blood-moon backlight as a hard rim silhouette on a rooftop, camera-flash bursts as strobing key, then near-total darkness with a single cold underlight from below for the final stare. Style & Mood: Neon-Gothic split-tone: bruised magentas, cyan/morgue-blue, sodium-amber pockets; cool pre-dawn damp air, strobe rhythm that collapses into silence. Dialogue in English. Acting: micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise. Narrative Summary: A ritual montage reveals the amber vial and spreads the amber-eyed contagion, ending on Lead Girl’s silent invitation into the lens. Scene Setup: Fragmented ritual space that jump-cuts between (1) a black void where manicured fingers hover over a small object, (2) a frosted classroom window glowing milky cyan, (3) an empty damp parking lot under harsh lamps, (4) a rooftop ledge under a swollen blood moon, then back to black void. First frame: high-angle ECU over Lead Girl’s manicured fingers centered at x≈50% y≈55%, the vial still obscured/indistinct in her grip; cold cyan spill and tiny amber speculars flicker across her nails. Dynamic Description: 75mm macro, high-angle, erratic handheld inches above Lead Girl’s fingers; cyan window-glow skims her knuckles while a tiny amber glint pulses in her palm. She rolls her wrist and rack-focus snaps the reveal: an ornate vial filled with amber liquid, the amber catching a stretched flare. Whip-pan from the vial to a frosted classroom window; behind the glass Boy 2 is centered at x≈50% y≈40%, eyes normal and guarded for a beat, then a strobe-flash pop makes them ignite amber-glowing, his lids tightening as if bracing for a hit that already landed. Smash Cut to a wide parking-lot fragment under harsh lamps: a girl in a pleated skirt crouches over a prone body at frame-right while casually texting at frame-left; blood smears her chin as damp asphalt shines in sodium-amber pools. Smash Cut to a rooftop ledge: a line of hooded figures silhouettes against the swollen blood moon, shoulders leaning forward as if ready to drop; wind tugs hoods and hems in short violent beats. Flash-frames strobe: a fang in close, an eye with molten flecks, a neon sign buzzing, a wrist flexing, the blood moon swelling—each frame separated by a camera-flash burst. Hard Cut to near-black; all strobe dies instantly. Dead-still, straight-on CU: Lead Girl dead-center at x≈50% y≈45%, eyes molten gold and wet with catch-lights, mouth bloody, a thin black tear clinging at the inner lower lid; her jaw relaxes into stillness, breath audible through her nose. Lead Girl [eyes locked to lens, lip presses then parts, voice barely above breath]: 'welcome to freshman year.' She holds the stare in total silence, throat working once, a slow blink like a door closing, breath continuing as the frame sinks darker around her without going fully black. Audio: Strobing camera-flash pops, fluorescent buzz behind frosted glass, distant electrical neon rasp, wind hiss on rooftop, parking-lot light hum, then a hard drop to total silence except Lead Girl’s breathing and a faint wet mouth-sound on the whisper. Positive Locks: Lead Girl keeps molten-gold eyes and the final dead-center straight-on stare with a mouth bloody and a single black tear detail. Boy 2 keeps amber-glowing eyes behind the milky-cyan frosted window. Neon-Gothic split-tone grade holds throughout: bruised magentas, cyan/morgue-blue, sodium-amber pockets, cool temperature and heavy highlight bloom. The final image is a dead-still centered lock on Lead Girl’s face with visible breath and living eye catch-lights. No subtitles. No text overlay. No captions. No title cards. No watermarks.
